mapper.select: select from lab_asset a join lab_member pm on pm.id=a.primary_owner_id and pm.del_flag='0' join sys_user pu on pu.user_id=pm.user_id and pu.del_flag='0' left join lab_member bm on bm.id=a.backup_owner_id and bm.del_flag='0' left join sys_user bu on bu.user_id=bm.user_id and bu.del_flag='0' where a.del_flag='0' and a.id=#{id}and a.asset_type=#{assetType} and a.asset_stage=#{assetStage}and a.status=#{status} and a.primary_owner_id=#{primaryOwnerId}and a.asset_name like concat('%',#{assetName},'%') order by a.status,a.asset_type,a.asset_name,a.id

select from lab_asset a join lab_member pm on pm.id=a.primary_owner_id and pm.del_flag='0' join sys_user pu on pu.user_id=pm.user_id and pu.del_flag='0' left join lab_member bm on bm.id=a.backup_owner_id and bm.del_flag='0' left join sys_user bu on bu.user_id=bm.user_id and bu.del_flag='0' where a.id=#{id} and a.del_flag='0'
select a.*,null primary_owner_name,null primary_owner_biz_line,null backup_owner_name,null backup_owner_status from lab_asset a where a.id=#{id} and a.del_flag='0' for update

select from lab_asset a join lab_member pm on pm.id=a.primary_owner_id and pm.del_flag='0' join sys_user pu on pu.user_id=pm.user_id and pu.del_flag='0' left join lab_member bm on bm.id=a.backup_owner_id and bm.del_flag='0' left join sys_user bu on bu.user_id=bm.user_id and bu.del_flag='0' where a.del_flag='0' and (a.primary_owner_id=#{memberId} or a.backup_owner_id=#{memberId}) order by a.status,a.asset_name
mapper.update: update lab_asset set asset_no=#{assetNo},asset_name=#{assetName},asset_version=#{assetVersion},asset_type=#{assetType},asset_stage=#{assetStage}, primary_owner_id=#{primaryOwnerId},backup_owner_id=#{backupOwnerId},test_set_url=#{testSetUrl},deploy_package_url=#{deployPackageUrl},document_url=#{documentUrl}, resource_url=#{resourceUrl},repository_url=#{repositoryUrl},capacity_desc=#{capacityDesc},reuse_count=#{reuseCount},critical_flag=#{criticalFlag},status=#{status},remark=#{remark}, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
update lab_asset set status='INACTIVE',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select from lab_one2one o join lab_member mm on mm.id=o.member_id and mm.del_flag='0' join sys_user mu on mu.user_id=mm.user_id and mu.del_flag='0' join lab_member lm on lm.id=o.leader_id and lm.del_flag='0' join sys_user lu on lu.user_id=lm.user_id and lu.del_flag='0' where o.del_flag='0' and o.member_id=#{memberId}and o.leader_id=#{leaderId} and o.status=#{status} order by o.meeting_date desc,o.id desc

select from lab_one2one o join lab_member mm on mm.id=o.member_id and mm.del_flag='0' join sys_user mu on mu.user_id=mm.user_id and mu.del_flag='0' join lab_member lm on lm.id=o.leader_id and lm.del_flag='0' join sys_user lu on lu.user_id=lm.user_id and lu.del_flag='0' where o.del_flag='0' and o.member_id=#{memberId} order by o.meeting_date desc,o.id desc
